Nioh 3 Samurai Sword Build - Righteous Lightning (Beginner Build)
In this Nioh 3 build guide, we're going to be taking a look at how to put together the Righteous Lightning build using a sword with the Samurai style as your main source of damage. I'll be showing you where to place your stats and skills to get the maximum impact for this build. As well as what equipment to use and what Guardian Spirits and Soul Cores to have. This is an early to mid game Nioh 3 build meant for player to put together for the early parts of the game and is strong, simple and effective to play throughout its entirety.
